necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease, documented by diagnosis code I25.10, and reports intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by dizziness and giddiness, consistent with codes R00.2 and R42. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease. This specific diagnostic modality is required to evaluate the clinical criteria that were previously deemed not met under the CO-50 denial.
